// Last-in-first-out access. Push and Pop return new collections.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stack_(abstract_data_type))
interface IStack<T>
    inherits ICountable
{
    Peek(x: Self): T;
    Push(x: Self, item: T): Self;
    Pop(x: Self): Self;
}
